text: When they flump a planches, they fril put it be- borne the flavor in flakes as manas, as that the foils- ing cell of them laid flat upon a scrapeplate, which is faltered upon a every thick wooden table, and the phanche being likewise, laid as the tape of the phanchet may take the time liman or each ride, and in their thick part.
